audit_status.source_base: Greek 2 Thessalonians text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: Compact draft reviewed for day-of-Lord correction, rebellion/apostasy, lawless one, restrainer, mystery of lawlessness, delusion language, election/standing firm. Non-sensational handling required.

verses.restored: Now we ask you, siblings, concerning the presence/arrival of our Lord Jesus Messiah and our gathering together to him,

familiar.text: Now we beseech you, brethren, by the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, and by our gathering together unto him,

modern.text: Now concerning the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ and our being gathered together to Him, we ask you, brothers,

original.text: Ἐρωτῶμεν δὲ ὑμᾶς, ἀδελφοί, ὑπὲρ τῆς παρουσίας τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ καὶ ἡμῶν ἐπισυναγωγῆς ἐπʼ αὐτόν,

verses.restored: that you not be quickly shaken from mind nor troubled, neither through spirit nor through word nor through letter as if from us, as though the day of the Lord has arrived.

familiar.text: That ye be not soon shaken in mind, or be troubled, neither by spirit, nor by word, nor by letter as from us, as that the day of Christ is at hand.

modern.text: not to be easily disconcerted or alarmed by any spirit or message or letter seeming to be from us, alleging that the Day of the Lord has already come.

original.text: εἰς τὸ μὴ ταχέως σαλευθῆναι ὑμᾶς ἀπὸ τοῦ νοὸς ⸀μηδὲ θροεῖσθαι μήτε διὰ πνεύματος μήτε διὰ λόγου μήτε διʼ ἐπιστολῆς ὡς διʼ ἡμῶν, ὡς ὅτι ἐνέστηκεν ἡ ἡμέρα τοῦ ⸀κυρίου.

verses.restored: Let no one deceive you in any way; because unless the rebellion/departure comes first and the human of lawlessness is unveiled, the son of ruin,

familiar.text: Let no man deceive you by any means: for that day shall not come, except there come a falling away first, and that man of sin be revealed, the son of perdition;

modern.text: Let no one deceive you in any way, for it will not come until the rebellion occurs and the man of lawlessness—the son of destruction—is revealed.

original.text: μή τις ὑμᾶς ἐξαπατήσῃ κατὰ μηδένα τρόπον· ὅτι ἐὰν μὴ ἔλθῃ ἡ ἀποστασία πρῶτον καὶ ἀποκαλυφθῇ ὁ ἄνθρωπος τῆς ⸀ἀνομίας, ὁ υἱὸς τῆς ἀπωλείας,

verses.restored: the one opposing and lifting himself above every so-called god or object of reverence, so that he sits in the temple of the Divine, displaying himself as if he is divine.

familiar.text: Who opposeth and exalteth himself above all that is called God, or that is worshipped; so that he as God sitteth in the temple of God, shewing himself that he is God.

modern.text: He will oppose and exalt himself above every so-called god or object of worship. So he will seat himself in the temple of God, proclaiming himself to be God.

original.text: ὁ ἀντικείμενος καὶ ὑπεραιρόμενος ἐπὶ πάντα λεγόμενον θεὸν ἢ σέβασμα, ὥστε αὐτὸν εἰς τὸν ναὸν τοῦ ⸀θεοῦ καθίσαι ἀποδεικνύντα ἑαυτὸν ὅτι ἔστιν θεός.

verses.restored: Do you not remember that while I was still with you, I was saying these things to you?

familiar.text: Remember ye not, that, when I was yet with you, I told you these things?

modern.text: Do you not remember that I told you these things while I was still with you?

original.text: οὐ μνημονεύετε ὅτι ἔτι ὢν πρὸς ὑμᾶς ταῦτα ἔλεγον ὑμῖν;

verses.restored: And now you know what restrains, so that he may be unveiled in his own season.

familiar.text: And now ye know what withholdeth that he might be revealed in his time.

modern.text: And you know what is now restraining him, so that he may be revealed at the proper time.

original.text: καὶ νῦν τὸ κατέχον οἴδατε, εἰς τὸ ἀποκαλυφθῆναι αὐτὸν ἐν τῷ ⸀ἑαυτοῦ καιρῷ·

verses.restored: For the mystery of lawlessness is already working; only the one restraining now will do so until out of the midst.

familiar.text: For the mystery of iniquity doth already work: only he who now letteth will let, until he be taken out of the way.

modern.text: For the mystery of lawlessness is already at work, but the one who now restrains it will continue until he is taken out of the way.

original.text: τὸ γὰρ μυστήριον ἤδη ἐνεργεῖται τῆς ἀνομίας· μόνον ὁ κατέχων ἄρτι ἕως ἐκ μέσου γένηται.

verses.restored: And then the lawless one will be unveiled, whom the Lord Jesus will consume by the breath of his mouth and make inactive by the appearance of his presence/arrival,

familiar.text: And then shall that Wicked be revealed, whom the Lord shall consume with the spirit of his mouth, and shall destroy with the brightness of his coming:

modern.text: And then the lawless one will be revealed, whom the Lord Jesus will slay with the breath of His mouth and annihilate by the majesty of His arrival.

original.text: καὶ τότε ἀποκαλυφθήσεται ὁ ἄνομος, ὃν ὁ κύριος ⸀Ἰησοῦς ⸀ἀνελεῖ τῷ πνεύματι τοῦ στόματος αὐτοῦ καὶ καταργήσει τῇ ἐπιφανείᾳ τῆς παρουσίας αὐτοῦ,

verses.restored: whose presence/arrival is according to the working of the adversarial one in all power and signs and wonders of falsehood,

familiar.text: Even him, whose coming is after the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders,

modern.text: The coming of the lawless one will be accompanied by the working of Satan, with every kind of power, sign, and false wonder,

original.text: οὗ ἐστιν ἡ παρουσία κατʼ ἐνέργειαν τοῦ Σατανᾶ ἐν πάσῃ δυνάμει καὶ σημείοις καὶ τέρασιν ψεύδους

verses.restored: and in every deceit of injustice among those perishing, because they did not receive the love of the truth so that they might be saved/healed.

familiar.text: And with all deceivableness of unrighteousness in them that perish; because they received not the love of the truth, that they might be saved.

modern.text: and with every wicked deception directed against those who are perishing, because they refused the love of the truth that would have saved them.

original.text: καὶ ἐν πάσῃ ἀπάτῃ ⸀ἀδικίας τοῖς ἀπολλυμένοις, ἀνθʼ ὧν τὴν ἀγάπην τῆς ἀληθείας οὐκ ἐδέξαντο εἰς τὸ σωθῆναι αὐτούς·

verses.restored: And because of this the Divine sends them a working of delusion, so that they trust the falsehood,

familiar.text: And for this cause God shall send them strong delusion, that they should believe a lie:

modern.text: For this reason God will send them a powerful delusion so that they believe the lie,

original.text: καὶ διὰ τοῦτο ⸀πέμπει αὐτοῖς ὁ θεὸς ἐνέργειαν πλάνης εἰς τὸ πιστεῦσαι αὐτοὺς τῷ ψεύδει,

verses.restored: so that all may be judged who did not trust the truth but took pleasure in injustice.

familiar.text: That they all might be damned who believed not the truth, but had pleasure in unrighteousness.

modern.text: in order that judgment may come upon all who have disbelieved the truth and delighted in wickedness. Stand Firm

original.text: ἵνα κριθῶσιν ⸀πάντες οἱ μὴ πιστεύσαντες τῇ ἀληθείᾳ ἀλλὰ εὐδοκήσαντες ⸀τῇ ἀδικίᾳ.

verses.restored: But we ought always to give thanks to the Divine concerning you, siblings beloved by the Lord, because the Divine chose you as firstfruit for salvation/healing in sanctification of Spirit and trust of truth,

familiar.text: But we are bound to give thanks alway to God for you, brethren beloved of the Lord, because God hath from the beginning chosen you to salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief of the truth:

modern.text: But we should always thank God for you, brothers who are loved by the Lord, because God has chosen you from the beginning to be saved by the sanctification of the Spirit and by faith in the truth.

original.text: Ἡμεῖς δὲ ὀφείλομεν εὐχαριστεῖν τῷ θεῷ πάντοτε περὶ ὑμῶν, ἀδελφοὶ ἠγαπημένοι ὑπὸ κυρίου, ὅτι εἵλατο ὑμᾶς ὁ θεὸς ⸀ἀπαρχὴν εἰς σωτηρίαν ἐν ἁγιασμῷ πνεύματος καὶ πίστει ἀληθείας,

verses.restored: into which he called you through our good news, into obtaining glory of our Lord Jesus Messiah.

familiar.text: Whereunto he called you by our gospel, to the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.

modern.text: To this He called you through our gospel, so that you may share in the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.

original.text: εἰς ⸀ὃ ἐκάλεσεν ὑμᾶς διὰ τοῦ εὐαγγελίου ἡμῶν, εἰς περιποίησιν δόξης τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ.

verses.restored: So then, siblings, stand firm and hold fast the traditions you were taught, whether through word or through our letter.

familiar.text: Therefore, brethren, stand fast, and hold the traditions which ye have been taught, whether by word, or our epistle.

modern.text: Therefore, brothers, stand firm and cling to the traditions we taught you, whether by speech or by letter.

original.text: ἄρα οὖν, ἀδελφοί, στήκετε, καὶ κρατεῖτε τὰς παραδόσεις ἃς ἐδιδάχθητε εἴτε διὰ λόγου εἴτε διʼ ἐπιστολῆς ἡμῶν.

verses.restored: Now may our Lord Jesus Messiah himself and Divine our Father, the One having loved us and given age-long comfort/encouragement and good hope in grace,

familiar.text: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God, even our Father, which hath loved us, and hath given us everlasting consolation and good hope through grace,

modern.text: Now may our Lord Jesus Christ Himself and God our Father, who by grace has loved us and given us eternal comfort and good hope,

original.text: Αὐτὸς δὲ ὁ κύριος ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦς Χριστὸς καὶ ⸀θεὸς ⸀ὁ πατὴρ ἡμῶν, ὁ ἀγαπήσας ἡμᾶς καὶ δοὺς παράκλησιν αἰωνίαν καὶ ἐλπίδα ἀγαθὴν ἐν χάριτι,

verses.restored: comfort/encourage your hearts and establish them in every good work and word.

familiar.text: Comfort your hearts, and stablish you in every good word and work.

modern.text: encourage your hearts and strengthen you in every good word and deed.

original.text: παρακαλέσαι ὑμῶν τὰς καρδίας καὶ ⸀στηρίξαι ἐν παντὶ ⸂ἔργῳ καὶ λόγῳ⸃ ἀγαθῷ.

translation_notes: This chapter must be handled non-sensationally. The lawless one and restraining force are not identified in the text; preserve ambiguity rather than mapping them onto modern targets.
Mystery of lawlessness names a hidden pattern already at work, not a license for paranoia or accusation.
The pastoral command is not panic but steadiness: do not be shaken, stand firm, hold fast, be comforted and established.
